freezeAnchor.amendmentReason: Before any counted cycle or validator existed, clarify that unchanged GHT is required only while the old Daily remains unawarded. The first terminal award/reset snapshot may necessarily expose a changed GHT/new cycle.
freezeAnchor.rule: The validator must hard-pin the commit and UTC containing this clarified freeze. Only observations strictly later than that final freeze commit may enter the prospective survival ledger.

whyLatencyAgnostic: Choosing actionLatencySeconds after observing outcomes would create selection bias. Instead every complete passive cycle records the entire bounded post-GHT survival path without selecting a latency threshold. A later independently frozen latency may classify every retained cycle deterministically; cycles may not be selectively included or excluded based on that latency.

cycleMustContinueUntil: or the predeclared observation horizon ends
frozenObservationUnit.terminalDefinition: First post-detection snapshot with changed winCount, decreased amount, or changed guaranteedHitTime. No later snapshots belong to that old-GHT cycle.

frozenOutputs.lastConfirmedUnawardedLagSeconds: latest retained state with old GHT, unchanged winCount and nondecreasing amount, measured from old GHT
frozenOutputs.firstObservedAwardOrResetLagSeconds: first terminal state measured from old GHT, if observed

laterDeterministicClassification.successAtLatencyL: cycle has a confirmed unchanged/unreset old-GHT state at or after detectionTimestamp + L
laterDeterministicClassification.failureAtLatencyL: terminal award/reset is observed strictly before detectionTimestamp + L
laterDeterministicClassification.ambiguousAtLatencyL: observation gaps or censoring do not establish either condition

operatorRuleSeparation.reason: The passive server-state survival path is an observable property independent of whether bet365 operationally adopts the provider first-bet-following-day rule. Rule adoption remains mandatory before translating survival into an executable first-bet race probability.
